Oil Rig Chest Locations & Loot

All three Oil Rigs, their chest spawn spots, golden chest rules and the top drops from each. Data verified against the wiki for Palworld 1.0.

Rig overview

RigCoordinatesEnemy levelKey mechanic
Barge Oil Rig (160, -280) Level 15-25 Earliest rig. No anti-air, safe to fly in. 3 large chest spawn spots.
Oil Rig (Rayne Syndicate) (580, -430) Level 55+ Anti-air laser turrets. 12 small chests at fixed spots + 1 large golden chest in one of 4 locations.
Platform Oil Rig (-1730, -1450) Level 60+ Hardest rig. Golden chest always guarded by a Rayne Syndicate helicopter — defeat it before opening.

Chest types & respawn rules

  • Standard chests — spawn at fixed spots on each rig. Loot small amounts of Crude Oil, gold, training manuals and Schematics.
  • Golden chest — one per reset, spawns in one of several predetermined (usually guarded) locations. This is where the best loot lives.
  • Respawn — chests and gun turrets respawn after several in-game days; enemies respawn when you move far enough away.

Barge Oil Rig

West of Marsh Island · (160, -280) · Level 15-25

Earliest rig. No anti-air, safe to fly in. 3 large chest spawn spots.

Chest locations

  • Inside tents on the southern end of the rig
  • Behind the Crusher near the tall tower
  • Inside the blue shack on the western end

Oil Rig (Rayne Syndicate)

East of Sunlit Isle · (580, -430) · Level 55+

Anti-air laser turrets. 12 small chests at fixed spots + 1 large golden chest in one of 4 locations.

Chest locations

  • 12 small chests at fixed positions across the structure
  • 1 golden chest spawning in 1 of 4 predetermined (guarded) locations
  • 1 small chest on top of a tall tower — use the ladder, destroy anti-air first if flying

Platform Oil Rig

East of Sunlit Isle (far) · (-1730, -1450) · Level 60+

Strategy tips

  • Bring a Homeward Thundercloud or a Dogen for quick escapes — anti-air makes flying out hard.
  • Destroy anti-air laser turrets with the console at their base; anti-air rocket platforms do not respawn.
  • On the Rayne Syndicate rig, the tower-top chest requires grappling the ladder — a guard sits at the top.
  • For the Platform rig, clear the helicopter first — the golden chest can't be opened while it's alive.
